name: Aspa (Spain)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with a white fleur-de-lis.
history: The official flag of Aspa is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, purple, with the white fleur-de-lis of the arms, 4/6 of the height of the cloth, at the centre; the town council began the adoption file on 16 May 2013 and the flag was approved on 18 April 2017 and published in the DOGC.
